interactives.label: Rules of the arcades
interactives.text: One party at a time. The dead wake at the customs hall. Waystones count you out. The court is the end of it.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The arcades
interactives.text: The customs house kept its arcades dry for three hundred years. The eleventh bell rang, the crown went under, and the arcades went with it.

interactives.label: Reward cache
interactives.text: The run's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.

interactives.label: The court is quiet
interactives.text: Whoever reads this walked the whole road. The cache is yours; the waystone is the way home.

gauntlet.name: The Drowned Arcades
gauntlet.flavour: The customs arcades of the old city, flooded to the knee since the crown went under, and full of what came up with the water.
